title: Personal Projects
intro: A selection of projects I've built in my free time — experiments, tools, and ideas turned into working software.

projects.title: KMSwitch
projects.description: An open-hardware keyboard/mouse switch (KVM) for two computers, built on the RP2040. Switch with a hotkey or by moving the mouse across the screen edge — no host software, works in the BIOS, with a shared microSD drive and galvanic isolation.
